reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Ali Hamed is the co-founder of CoVenture and Managing Partner of the CoVenture VC Fund.
reader_summary.overview: Ali Hamed is the co-founder of CoVenture and Managing Partner of the CoVenture VC Fund. CoVenture is an innovative company that identifies and invests in novel assets formed by the intersection of technology and finance. The firm manages an early stage venture capital fund, direct lending fund, and crypto asset index fund, with each taking a creative twist on its market.

key_points.text: Our conversation starts with Ali's entrepreneurial path to the creation of CoVenture, and covers examples of previously unpriced investment opportunities, including produce receivables.
We walk through the world of crypto assets and the state of the venture capital industry.
Ali's fresh lens on the world offers a fascinating perspective on every aspect of early stage investing.
